title: ACP mana/test/run runs tests in any client-supplied cwd
body:
Found while working on #976.

\`mana/test/run\` in \`node-bot/mana-acp-agent.js\` passes \`params.cwd\` straight to the test runner without checking it, so an allowed command like \`npm test\` or \`node --test\` can run in any folder on the machine.

What I want:
- Restrict \`cwd\` to the session's repo root or a git worktree of it, and refuse anything else.
- Compare real paths the way #1001 does (links, 8.3 names, trailing dots, case), so a junction or a short name can't get around it.
- Tests.
interface: `mana/test/run` refuses a cwd outside the session repo or its worktrees with an error whose message contains "inside the session's repo", and never calls the test runner for it. A relative cwd is resolved against the session's cwd; no cwd means the session's cwd.
why: A security fix: restrict a client-supplied cwd to the repo or its worktrees. Edge cases matter, which is what the adversarial reviewer should catch.
